hero.title: Welcome to UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ
hero.description: UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ is the digital home of the Bangladeshi Students' Association at UMass Lowell, bringing together the people, events, resources, stories, and shared traditions that shape our community. Whether you are new to Lowell, already part of the association, or simply looking to stay connected, this is a place to find what matters across BSA UML.
